extra.final_summary: Found and fixed three data issues: (1) Category labels had space and case variants (e.g., ' Office Supplies ' → 'Office Supplies'), which were normalized; (2) One exact duplicate row (row 31) was removed to prevent double-counting; (3) One row (row 40) with Quantity = -6 was excluded as it violates the rule that Quantity must be at least 1. The Revenue column was validated against the formula Quantity * Price and found consistent. The final count of orders by category is: Accessories (9), Electronics (11), Furniture (14), Office Supplies (12).
